name: MAC
summary: **MAC** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Capulator|Capulator]]. A cross of [[alien-cookies|Alien Cookies]] and [[miracle-15|Miracle 15]], itself a hybrid of [[starfighter|Starfighter]] and a Colombian landrace, it is grown as a [[label:hybrid|hybrid]]. Its precise origin date remains undocumented, and the original cut is distributed selectively.
